base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (OCF -$161.136M = FY25 -$157.240M - H1'25 -$84.346M + H1'26 -$88.242M; minus SBC TTM $12.982M and capex ~$0 = -$174.118M / 122.679M H1'26 diluted shares); normalized 3-yr median was -$2.06 and latest FY -$1.83 — all bases negative, Tier F under every base — see analysis.md
moat_justification: Weak and approval-contingent: first-mover lead in psilocybin therapy (two positive Phase 3 TRD trials, Breakthrough Therapy designation, priority-review voucher, rolling NDA underway) plus formulation/use patents and site-network know-how, but the active molecule is a known natural compound competitors can route around (Definium DT120, Lilly/AtaiBeckley BPL-003 with a ~2h session vs COMP360's ~6-8h supervised session, AbbVie/Gilgamesh), no pricing power or payer coverage is proven, functional unblinding is a live criticism, and Schedule I rescheduling sits between approval and revenue.
name: COMPASS Pathways plc
one_liner: Pre-revenue single-asset psychedelic biotech, moat 3/10 contingent on approval — owner's earnings are negative in all 7 years of history (-$1.42/share TTM) despite two positive Phase 3 TRD trials and $382.6M net cash, so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; the $11.60 price is an FDA-approval option, not an earnings stream.
